hero.name: Salomon Kabongo
hero.lede: Nasalaka bolukiluki (recherche) mpo na koyeba ndenge ba machine eyekolaka minoko — pe nalakisaka yango na Anglais, Français, Lingala pe Tshiluba.
hero.description: Mosala na ngai ezali na katsikatsi ya makambo mibale oyo ekutanaka mbala mingi te : recherche ya NLP oyo bato ya mayele ba talela, pe komema boyebi yango epai ya bato oyo ekomamaki mpo na bango te. Natongaka technologie ya minoko mpo na minoko ya Afrique, nasalaka AI appliquée na ba entreprise, pe na expliquaka nionso mibale na YouTube.
hero.now_role: Lead Software Engineer, Innovation Group na State Farm
hero.now_phd: PhD na Informatique, Leibniz Universität Hannover
hero.now_masakhane: Ancien membre ya conseil, Masakhane Research Foundation

about.title: Technologie ya monoko mpo na bato oyo basila kobosanama mbala mingi
about.bio1: Nazali na doctorat (PhD) na Informatique uta Leibniz Universität Hannover, esika recherche na ngai etalaki traitement ya monoko naturel (NLP), extraction ya makambo pe graphe ya boyebi — mingi mingi, ndenge ya kobimisa na grande échelle ba résultat structuré pe comparable na kati ya littérature scientifique.
about.bio2: Na Innovation Group ya State Farm, na kambaka recherche appliquée na computer vision, intelligence documentaire pe AI générative — mosala oyo ebimisi brevet moko ya AI/ML pe ba dépôt misato mosusu. Na conseil ya Masakhane Research Foundation, na sungaki programme ya koleka 9M$ mpo na kotonga infrastructure NLP ouverte mpo na koleka milliard moko ya bato oyo balobaka minoko ya Afrique.
about.bio3: Recherche pe kolakisa ezali projet se moko. Article oyo ekei kaka epai ya bato oyo basila koyeba kotanga Anglais ezali article oyo esilisi mosala na yango te — yango wana nalakisaka na Anglais, Français, Lingala pe Tshiluba.
research_items: Traitement ya monoko naturel (NLP) pe Large Language Models
Reconnaissance pe traduction ya maloba mpo na minoko oyo ezali na ba ressource moke
Graphe ya boyebi pe extraction ya makambo ya scientifique
about.darakili: Conviction wana nde esali ete nasala na DarAkili, plateforme ya éducation STEM esika ba professionnel ya Afrique babimisaka minicours ofele na minoko na bango moko.

speaking.home_title: Baconférence, bacours pe ba table ronde
speaking.home_subtitle: Nalobaka liboso ya ba chercheur pe liboso ya bato nionso, na Anglais to na Français, mpo na recherche ya AI, technologie ya minoko ya Afrique, pe nini esengeli mpo na kotonga nionso mibale.
speaking.title: Baconférence
speaking.subtitle: Nalobaka na ba université, ba groupe ya recherche, baconférence pe ba entreprise — na Anglais to Français, en ligne to na présentiel.
speaking.topic_1_title: Esika ba grand modèle ya monoko ekweyaka penza
speaking.topic_1_desc: Lisolo ya chercheur oyo azali kosala mpo na nini ba système ya lelo esalaka malamu, esika ebukanaka, pe ndenge ya koyeba bokeseni — mpo na public technique, kozanga kosenga expertise ya NLP.
speaking.topic_2_title: AI mpo na minoko ya Afrique
speaking.topic_2_desc: Mpo na nini koleka milliard moko ya bato bazangi naino technologie ya monoko, nini Masakhane pe communauté batongi, pe nzela ya solo oyo etikali liboso.
speaking.topic_3_title: Uta na recherche kino na production
speaking.topic_3_desc: Komema machine learning uta na article kino na système oyo esalemi pe ezwi brevet na kati ya organisation monene — pe ba compromis oyo moto akomaka te.
speaking.topic_4_title: Kotonga carrière ya recherche uta na pembeni
speaking.topic_4_desc: Mpo na ba étudiant pe ba chercheur ya sika oyo bazali libanda ya nzela ya momesano : ndenge ya koluka ba collaborateur, kobimisa ba article, pe kondimama.
speaking.invite_body: Yebisa ngai mpo na public na yo, date pe format. Nayanolaka na demande nionso, pe nasepelaka kobongisa conférence kotalela oyo groupe na yo ezali kosala.

consulting.title: Conseil pe accompagnement
consulting.subtitle: Accompagnement indépendant mpo na ba équipe oyo ezali kotonga na ba modèle ya monoko, AI documentaire, to technologie ya minoko ya Afrique.
consulting.area_1_title: Ba système NLP pe LLM appliqués
consulting.area_1_desc: Ba revue ya architecture, conception ya évaluation, pe avis ya solo mpo na koyeba soki modèle ya monoko ezali penza outil oyo ebongi na problème na yo.
consulting.area_2_desc: Ba pipeline ya extraction, classification pe compréhension mpo na ba document ya solo oyo ezali complexe — domaine ya mosala na ngai ya brevet.
consulting.area_3_desc: Stratégie ya ba donnée, partenariat na communauté pe choix ya ba modèle mpo na ba équipe oyo ezali kotonga mpo na ba marché ya Afrique pe ba utilisateur multilingue.
consulting.area_4_desc: Mpo na ba laboratoire pe ba fondation : direction ya recherche, stratégie ya publication, pe kotonga ba collaboration oyo ekowumela koleka cycle ya liboso ya financement.
consulting.format_1_desc: Appel moko mpo na kotalela décision. Mbala mingi ekoki.
consulting.format_2_desc: Examen ya système, ya ba donnée to ya plan ya recherche, epesami lokola évaluation ekomami.
consulting.format_3_desc: Mosala oyo ezongelaka na équipe na boumeli ya trimestre to koleka.
consulting.cta_body: Appel ya liboso ezali ofele pe ezali na but mosusu te longola kaka koyeba soki nakoki penza kosalisa yo. Soki nazali moto oyo ebongi te, nakoyebisa yo pe nakolakisa yo moto mosusu.
